test_title: PYST 14: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets. 

(13, 12, 2) 

(25, 22, 6)
solution: The logic followed here is: Logic: **2nd Number + (3rd Number ÷ 2) = 1st Number**. Now, (13, 12, 2) ⇒ 12 + (2 ÷ 2) ⇒ 12 + 1 = 13. (25, 22, 6) ⇒ 22 + (6 ÷ 2) ⇒ 22 + 3 = 25. Now, checking the options: Option 1) (26, 22, 10)
